newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan brass mill output rises 3.0 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Japan brass mill output rises 3.0 pct in November.

text.p: Japan's brass mill output in November rose 3.0 percent from the same month a year ago to a seasonally adjusted 102,457 tonnes, according to preliminary data released on Friday by the Japan Brass Makers Association.
This was the second month of year-on-year output increases. Last month's 1.6 percent increase broke a 13-month streak of consecutive declines.
The association released preliminary November data for output only. All other statistics were final figures for October, as follows (in tonnes):
*(NOTE: October output figure revised, seasonally adjusted.)

The October data showed that shipments to the semiconductor sector remained well below year-ago levels while the automotive and air conditioning/refrigeration sectors showed marginal year-on-year increases.
Growth in shipments was particularly strong in the construction and electric equipment sectors.
